_comment: IDENTITY TABLE (master sheet, 2026-08-08). Real name <-> Sleeper handle <-> Sleeper owner_id. The history page and settlement render REAL NAMES; money_history keys on owner_id. _pre_sleeper: The master sheet carries real names + standings + payouts for 2016-2022 (pre-Sleeper). Those years key on real name only (no owner_id) and are tagged source:master_sheet in the history page.
